verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Polar platform itself is open source under Apache-2.0 at github.com/polarsource/polar, and it brands itself as an open source Merchant of Record. That makes running it yourself plausible, but nothing in the pack documents a supported self-hosting path. The core Merchant of Record value (tax liability, remittance, payouts) is also inherently tied to Polar's hosted service. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting/deployment guide, official support for self-hosted instances, clarity on which features (MoR, payments) work when self-hosted, hands-on corroboration of running it independently.
